001: Haoran, is your dorm far from the teaching building?
Not far, it takes ten minutes to walk there.
That's pretty convenient. My dorm is on the sixth floor.
The sixth floor has no elevator. It must be tiring climbing the stairs every day, right?
You get used to it, and it's a good way to exercise.
True, and living high up means a nice view too.
002: What time does your roommate usually go to bed at night?
He sleeps pretty early, he turns off the lights around eleven.
No, I'm used to sleeping early anyway.
That's good, having matching schedules is important.
Yeah, we get along really well.
003: The cafeteria was so crowded today. What did you eat?
I got braised pork and greens, it tasted pretty good.
I didn't feel like going to the cafeteria, so I had a bowl of instant noodles.
Eating instant noodles all the time is no good for your health.
I know, I'll definitely eat at the cafeteria tomorrow.
How about we go together tomorrow? I'll buy you some soup.
004: The air conditioner in the dorm seems to be broken, it's so hot.
Did you put in a repair request? Someone should come pretty quickly.
Not yet, I don't know how to request a repair.
You just submit it on your phone, it's very easy.
Okay, I'll try it right now.
If that doesn't work, go find the dorm manager.
005: Do you usually stay in the dorm on weekends?
Most of the time, yeah, but I go out for a walk once in a while.
Same here, I feel like the dorm is the most comfortable place.
But staying in all the time gets stuffy, you need to go out and get some fresh air.
Then how about we go to the park together this weekend?
Sure, I've been wanting to get some exercise anyway.
006: Do you keep any plants in your dorm?
I have a pothos, it's on the windowsill.
I want to get one too, but I'm afraid I can't keep it alive.
Pothos is super easy to take care of, you just need to water it a bit.
Really? Then I'll buy one and try it too.
Yeah, it also makes the room look more lively.
007: The room next door was so loud last night. Did you hear it?
Yeah, I heard it. Sounded like they were having a party.
I didn't sleep well, I'm a bit tired today.
How about saying something to them? Everyone should be considerate of each other.
Forget it, once in a while is no big deal.
You're so easygoing. If it were me, I would've gone knocking on their door already.
008: How's the internet speed in your dorm?
Pretty good, watching videos and playing games without any lag.
Mine keeps disconnecting, it's so annoying.
It might be a router problem, try restarting it.
I already tried that, it's still not very stable.
Then call the internet company and ask about it.
009: Do you usually cook in the dorm?
I boil noodles once in a while, but stir-frying is not very convenient.
We have a small electric pot in our dorm, we can cook hot pot with it.
That's nice, hot pot is the best in winter.
Next time I'll invite you to join us, it'll be more fun.
Sounds good, I'll be in charge of buying and washing the vegetables.
010: The break is coming up soon. When are you going home?
I bought a ticket for next Wednesday.
So you need to pack up all your stuff in the dorm, right?
Yeah, I need to put the blanket away so it doesn't get dusty.
If you need any help, just say the word.
